subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

The cow happily recovered, which the widow entirely attributed to the __efficacy__ of her pastor's prayer.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Inadequacy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"efficacy"** means the ability to produce a desired or intended result. (प्रभावशीलता)

 
 
• **Example:** The efficacy of the new drug was proven through rigorous testing.
 
 
 
• **"Inadequacy"** refers to the lack of ability to deal with a situation or meet expectations; it indicates insufficiency. (अपर्याप्तता)
 
 
• **Example:** The inadequacy of the old equipment was evident during the critical operation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'efficacy'** is **'inadequacy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Potency **(शक्ति): The power of something to affect the mind or body.

 
 
• **Example:** The potency of the medicine was evident in its quick results.
 
 
 
• **Virtue **(गुण): Behavior showing high moral standards.
 
 
• **Example:** Patience is considered a virtue in many cultures.
 
 
 
• **Effect **(प्रभाव): A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.
 
 
• **Example:** The effect of the new policy was felt almost immediately.
